name: Bella
description: Bella is an easygoing lab mix who loves playing fetch and riding in the car. She knows basic commands and walks well on a leash.
rescueStory: Rescued from an industrial area in Section 19, Petaling Jaya. Bella has lived in foster care with a family with two school-aged children and another dog. She is house-trained and crate trained.

medical.specialNeeds: Core 6-in-1 vaccination complete. Monthly NexGard Spectra given.

medicalTimeline.title: Sanctuary Rescue & Initial Intake Screening
medicalTimeline.description: Rescued safely from Section 19 Petaling Jaya industrial lot. Body weight 20.5kg, BCS 4/9. General physical examination clear.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Diselamatkan dari kawasan industri Seksyen 19 Petaling Jaya. Berat badan 20.5kg, skor keadaan badan 4/9. Pemeriksaan fizikal am normal.
medicalTimeline.veterinarian: Dr. Sarah Tan, DVM (PJ Animal Hospital)

medicalTimeline.title: Diagnostic Bloodwork & Infectious Disease Screen
medicalTimeline.titleMs: Ujian Darah Diagnostik & Saringan Penyakit Berjangkit
medicalTimeline.description: Canine Parvovirus (CPV) and Canine Distemper Virus (CDV) antigen tests NEGATIVE. Complete blood count within standard reference ranges.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Ujian antigen Parvovirus dan Distemper NEGATIF. Ujian darah lengkap dalam julat normal.
medicalTimeline.veterinarian: Dr. Sarah Tan, DVM (PJ Animal Hospital)

medicalTimeline.title: Parasite Treatment & Prophylaxis
medicalTimeline.description: Broad-spectrum internal deworming with Drontal Plus administered. Monthly NexGard Spectra applied for flea, tick, and heartworm prevention.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Ubat cacing spektrum luas Drontal Plus diberikan. NexGard Spectra bulanan untuk pencegahan kutu, pinjal dan cacing jantung.
medicalTimeline.veterinarian: Dr. Sarah Tan, DVM (PJ Animal Hospital)

medicalTimeline.title: Core Immunization (DHPPi + Lepto 6-in-1)
medicalTimeline.description: Administered annual booster for Distemper, Hepatitis, Parvovirus, Parainfluenza, and Leptospirosis.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Suntikan vaksin penggalak tahunan untuk Distemper, Hepatitis, Parvovirus, Parainfluenza, dan Leptospirosis.

medicalTimeline.title: Elective Ovariohysterectomy (Spay Surgery)
medicalTimeline.description: Routine sterilization performed under general isoflurane anesthesia. Post-op recovery uneventful, incision site healed cleanly.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Pembedahan pemandulan rutin di bawah bius umum. Pemulihan lancar, luka sembuh sempurna.
medicalTimeline.veterinarian: Dr. Sarah Tan, DVM (PJ Animal Hospital)

medicalTimeline.title: ISO Microchip & Full Adoption Clearance
medicalTimeline.titleMs: Cip Mikro ISO & Pelepasan Adopsi Penuh
medicalTimeline.description: Implanted ISO 11784/11785 15-digit RFID microchip. Final veterinary health passport certified for unconditional adoption rehoming.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Pemasangan cip mikro RFID 15 digit piawaian ISO 11784/11785. Pasport kesihatan veterinar disahkan sedia untuk diangkat anak.
medicalTimeline.veterinarian: Dr. Sarah Tan, DVM (PJ Animal Hospital)

name: Milo
description: Milo is a friendly young tabby who likes wand toys, window perches, and sleeping near people while they work.
rescueStory: Found as a stray kitten near SS2, Petaling Jaya. He has spent the last two months in a foster home where he coexisted smoothly with other adult cats.

medical.specialNeeds: Tested negative for FIV/FeLV. Fully litter box reliable.

medicalTimeline.title: Sanctuary Rescue & Quarantine Intake
medicalTimeline.description: Brought in from SS2 Petaling Jaya commercial zone. Alert, responsive, clear eyes and ears. Weight 3.8kg.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Diselamatkan dari zon komersial SS2 Petaling Jaya. Cergas, mata dan telinga bersih. Berat 3.8kg.

medicalTimeline.title: Feline Retrovirus Serology Screening
medicalTimeline.description: FIV antibody & FeLV antigen combo test NEGATIVE. Feline Coronavirus antibody screen negative.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Ujian antibodi FIV & antigen FeLV NEGATIF. Saringan Coronavirus kucing negatif.

medicalTimeline.title: Core FVRCP Tri-Cat Immunization
medicalTimeline.description: Vaccinated against Feline Viral Rhinotracheitis, Calicivirus, and Panleukopenia.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Suntikan vaksin terhadap Rhinotracheitis, Calicivirus, dan Panleukopenia.

medicalTimeline.title: Castration Surgery (Neuter) & Microchipping
medicalTimeline.description: Standard bilateral orchiectomy completed under anesthesia. Microchip implanted subcutaneously between scapulae.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Pembedahan kembiri bilateral selesai di bawah bius. Cip mikro dipasang pada bawah kulit bahu.

medicalTimeline.title: Foster Socialization & Rehoming Sign-off
medicalTimeline.description: Completed litter box reliability and cat-friendly socialization trial. 100% cleared for adoption placement.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Selesai ujian kebolehpercayaan tandas pasir dan keserasian bersama kucing lain. Lulus 100% untuk adopsi.

name: Luna
description: Luna is a smart, active dog who needs regular exercise and daily walks. Best suited for an active household with a secure compound.
rescueStory: Surrendered by an owner relocating overseas. Luna knows basic obedience commands (sit, stay, shake). She has strong prey drive so she cannot be in a home with cats.

medical.specialNeeds: Healthy. Vaccinations and heartworm prevention up to date.

medicalTimeline.title: Owner Surrender Intake & Health Assessment
medicalTimeline.description: Intake via owner relocation handover. Comprehensive physical exam, dental grading 1/4, strong musculoskeletal condition.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Kemasukan melalui penyerahan pemilik. Pemeriksaan fizikal menyeluruh, keadaan otot dan rangka sangat baik.

medicalTimeline.title: IDEXX 4Dx Vector-Borne Screening
medicalTimeline.description: Screened for Heartworm, Anaplasma, Ehrlichia, and Lyme disease. All panels returned NEGATIVE.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Saringan untuk cacing jantung, Anaplasma, Ehrlichia, dan penyakit Lyme. Semua panel NEGATIF.

medicalTimeline.title: Vaccination Booster & Rabies Protection
medicalTimeline.description: Administered DHPPi 6-in-1 core booster plus Rabies vaccination certificate for municipal compliance.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Suntikan penggalak teras DHPPi 6-dalam-1 beserta sijil vaksinasi Rabies mengikut piawaian majlis bandaraya.

medicalTimeline.title: Behavioral Evaluation & Adoption Clearance
medicalTimeline.description: Demonstrated excellent leash recall and basic obedience. High prey drive towards cats noted for adopter matching.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Menunjukkan kemahiran asas mendengar arahan yang cemerlang. Naluri memburu kucing direkodkan bagi pemadanan rumah.

name: Oliver
description: Oliver is an energetic ginger kitten who loves feather toys, climbing scratching posts, and curling up for afternoon naps.
rescueStory: Rescued alongside two littermates from a back alley in Damansara Utama. Hand-raised in foster care, well socialized, and loves human company.

medicalTimeline.title: Neonatal Rescue Intake & Foster Placement
medicalTimeline.description: Rescued from Damansara Utama back alley with mild dehydration. Started on nutritional support and fluid therapy.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Diselamatkan dari lorong belakang Damansara Utama dengan dehidrasi ringan. Rawatan sokongan nutrisi dan cecair dimulakan.

medicalTimeline.title: Pediatric Deworming & Spot-on Protocol
medicalTimeline.description: Administered Revolution for kittens for internal worms, ear mites, and fleas.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Diberikan Revolution khas anak kucing untuk cacing dalaman, hama telinga dan pinjal.

medicalTimeline.title: Kitten FVRCP Vaccination Series Completed
medicalTimeline.titleMs: Siri Vaksinasi FVRCP Anak Kucing Selesai
medicalTimeline.description: Completed booster immunizations for feline distemper and respiratory viruses.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Selesai suntikan penggalak untuk distemper kucing dan virus pernafasan.

medicalTimeline.title: Early Pediatric Neuter & Microchip Registry
medicalTimeline.description: Neutered safely once body weight exceeded 1.8kg. ISO microchip implanted.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Pembedahan kembiri selamat selepas berat melebihi 1.8kg. Cip mikro ISO dipasang.

name: Rocky
description: Rocky is a gentle, calm local mixed dog who walks politely on a leash and spends most of his day relaxing.
rescueStory: Rescued from Kelana Jaya after being abandoned. Rocky is quiet, does not bark at neighbours or passersby, and enjoys peaceful walks around the park.

medical.specialNeeds: Daily omega-3 fish oil supplement for coat health.

medicalTimeline.title: Rescue Intake & Trauma Screening
medicalTimeline.description: Rescued from roadside in Kelana Jaya. Mild dehydration, no skeletal fractures found on X-ray.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Diselamatkan di tepi jalan Kelana Jaya. Dehidrasi ringan, tiada kepatahan tulang dikesan pada X-ray.

medicalTimeline.title: Bloodwork & Tick Fever Treatment Course
medicalTimeline.description: Completed standard doxycycline course for mild tick fever. Full platelet recovery verified.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Selesai rawatan doxycycline untuk demam kutu ringan. Pemulihan platelet darah disahkan sepenuhnya.

medicalTimeline.title: Core Vaccination (DHPPi 6-in-1)
medicalTimeline.description: Booster vaccination completed with rabies clearance.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Suntikan penggalak vaksin selesai bersama pengesahan rabies.

medicalTimeline.title: Castration Surgery & Microchip Registration
medicalTimeline.description: Routine sterilization completed. Microchip registration verified in central shelter ledger.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Pembedahan kembiri rutin selesai. Pendaftaran cip mikro disahkan dalam rekod pusat perlindungan.

name: Cleo
description: Cleo is a calm adult calico cat who enjoys gentle brushing and watching birds from a balcony window.
rescueStory: Surrendered when her previous owner moved into a no-pet condominium. Cleo is low maintenance, gentle, and perfectly suited for condo or apartment living.

medical.specialNeeds: Routine dental check completed in May 2026.

medicalTimeline.title: Surrender Intake & Comprehensive Feline Exam
medicalTimeline.description: Owner surrender health intake. BCS 5/9, beautiful calico coat, clear cardiopulmonary sounds.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Pemeriksaan kesihatan kemasukan serahan. Skor badan 5/9, bulu calico cantik, paru-paru dan jantung sihat.

medicalTimeline.title: FIV/FeLV Serology & Diagnostic Blood Panel
medicalTimeline.description: Snap combo test negative for FIV/FeLV. Renal and hepatic biochemistry profiles within optimal ranges.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Ujian pantas negatif FIV/FeLV. Profil buah pinggang dan fungsi hati dalam keadaan optimum.

medicalTimeline.title: Ultrasonic Dental Scaling & Polishing
medicalTimeline.description: Prophylactic dental scale and polish performed under sedation. Gums healthy, no tooth extractions needed.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Penskaleran gigi profilaktik di bawah sedasi. Gusi sihat tanpa keperluan cabutan gigi.

medicalTimeline.title: Annual FVRCP Booster & Microchip Audit
medicalTimeline.titleMs: Suntikan Penggalak FVRCP & Audit Cip Mikro
medicalTimeline.description: Core 3-in-1 FVRCP booster administered. Microchip serial scanned and confirmed.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Suntikan penggalak 3-dalam-1 FVRCP diberikan. Nombor siri cip mikro diimbas dan disahkan.

name: Barnaby
description: Barnaby is a sweet older beagle mix looking for a quiet home with short morning walks and a comfy bed.
rescueStory: Surrendered after an elderly owner passed away in Petaling Jaya. Barnaby is gentle, fully house-trained, and rarely barks.

medical.specialNeeds: Senior blood panel clear. Takes glucosamine for mild joint stiffness.

medicalTimeline.title: Sanctuary Intake & Senior Geriatric Assessment
medicalTimeline.description: Intake following bereavement in PJ. Comprehensive senior wellness checkup. Heart rhythm normal.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Kemasukan susulan kematian pemilik di PJ. Pemeriksaan kesihatan menyeluruh warga emas. Ritma jantung normal.

medicalTimeline.title: Full Senior Chemistry Panel & Joint Evaluation
medicalTimeline.titleMs: Panel Kimia Lengkap Senior & Penilaian Sendi
medicalTimeline.description: Full blood panel (CBC, liver, kidney, electrolytes) completely clean. Mild lumbar stiffness managed with daily joint supplements.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Ujian darah lengkap (CBC, fungsi hati, buah pinggang, elektrolit) bersih. Ketegangan sendi ringan diuruskan dengan suplemen harian.

medicalTimeline.title: Vaccination Booster & Heartworm Prophylaxis
medicalTimeline.description: Gentle senior booster protocol administered. Monthly NexGard Spectra recorded.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Protokol suntikan penggalak warga emas diberikan. NexGard Spectra bulanan direkodkan.

medicalTimeline.title: Comfort Clearance & Adoption Authorization
medicalTimeline.description: Barnaby has adapted wonderfully to sanctuary routine. Cleared for a peaceful, loving home.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Barnaby menyesuaikan diri dengan cemerlang. Diberi kelulusan untuk keluarga yang tenang dan penyayang.

name: Daisy
description: Daisy is an active puppy learning basic house manners. She is eager to please and needs a patient family committed to puppy training.
rescueStory: Rescued from a construction site in Kota Damansara. Currently living in foster care with another dog, doing well with pee-pad and outdoor potty training.

medicalTimeline.title: Construction Site Rescue & Puppy Health Check
medicalTimeline.titleMs: Penyelamatan Tapak Binaan & Pemeriksaan Anak Anjing
medicalTimeline.description: Safely rescued from a construction site in Kota Damansara. Cleaned, warmed, and given puppy nutritional paste.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Diselamatkan dengan selamat dari tapak pembinaan di Kota Damansara. Dibersihkan dan diberikan gel nutrisi anak anjing.

medicalTimeline.title: Canine Parvovirus & Giardia Diagnostic Panel
medicalTimeline.description: Snap CPV and fecal Giardia test returned completely negative.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Ujian pantas CPV dan najis Giardia negatif sepenuhnya.

medicalTimeline.title: Puppy Core 6-in-1 Vaccination Series
medicalTimeline.description: DHPPi booster course administered with zero post-vaccine fever.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Suntikan penggalak DHPPi diberikan tanpa sebarang demam selepas suntikan.

medicalTimeline.title: Spay Surgery & ISO Microchip Implantation
medicalTimeline.titleMs: Pembedahan Mandul & Pemasangan Cip Mikro ISO
medicalTimeline.description: Sterilization completed smoothly. Microchip registered for 100% free adoption.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Pembedahan pemandulan selesai dengan lancar. Cip mikro didaftarkan untuk adopsi 100% percuma.

name: Tuah
description: Tuah is a calm, people-oriented kampung dog recovering from a road traffic accident. He is not yet available for adoption — he is completing orthopaedic rehabilitation and hydrotherapy at the Rehabilitation House, and will be listed once his surgeon clears him.
rescueStory: Hit by a car along Jalan Universiti and found immobile at the roadside by a campus feeder. Emergency transport was arranged the same night; radiographs confirmed a pelvic fracture. Tuah has been under continuous veterinary care since intake and remains one of the sanctuary's most patient patients.

medical.specialNeeds: Pelvic fracture repair — cage rest with twice-weekly hydrotherapy. Neutering scheduled after orthopaedic clearance.

medicalTimeline.title: Emergency Road Traffic Accident Intake
medicalTimeline.description: Presented recumbent after vehicle impact along Jalan Universiti. Stabilised with IV fluids and analgesia. Weight 17.2kg, BCS 3/9.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Dibawa masuk dalam keadaan tidak boleh bangun selepas dilanggar di Jalan Universiti. Distabilkan dengan cecair IV dan ubat tahan sakit. Berat 17.2kg, skor keadaan badan 3/9.
medicalTimeline.veterinarian: Dr. Sarah Tan, DVM (PJ Animal Hospital)

medicalTimeline.title: Radiographic Diagnostics & Blood Profile
medicalTimeline.description: Full-body radiographs confirmed a closed pelvic fracture with no spinal involvement. Haematology and biochemistry within normal limits.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Radiografi seluruh badan mengesahkan patah tulang pelvis tertutup tanpa melibatkan tulang belakang. Hematologi dan biokimia dalam julat normal.
medicalTimeline.veterinarian: Dr. Sarah Tan, DVM (PJ Animal Hospital)

medicalTimeline.title: Pelvic Fracture Fixation Surgery
medicalTimeline.description: Internal fixation performed under general anaesthesia. Recovery uneventful; strict cage rest prescribed for six weeks.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Pembedahan fiksasi dalaman dilakukan di bawah bius penuh. Pemulihan lancar; rehat sangkar ketat selama enam minggu.

medicalTimeline.title: Core Vaccination & Deworming Restart
medicalTimeline.description: 6-in-1 core vaccine administered once systemically stable. Internal deworming and flea/tick preventative given.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Vaksin teras 6-dalam-1 diberikan setelah keadaan stabil. Nyahcacing dalaman dan pencegah kutu diberikan.

updates.title: First steps without support
updates.content: One week after surgery Tuah took his first unaided steps across the recovery pen. Weight-bearing on the left hind limb is improving daily.
updates.contentMs: Seminggu selepas pembedahan, Tuah mengambil langkah pertamanya tanpa bantuan di kandang pemulihan. Keupayaan menanggung berat pada kaki belakang kiri bertambah baik setiap hari.

updates.title: Hydrotherapy sessions begin
updates.content: Twice-weekly hydrotherapy has started to rebuild hind limb muscle. Tuah is calm in the water and greets his physiotherapist at the gate.
updates.contentMs: Hidroterapi dua kali seminggu telah bermula untuk membina semula otot kaki belakang. Tuah tenang di dalam air dan menyambut ahli fisioterapinya di pintu pagar.

name: Comel
description: Comel came through the campus TNRM programme with severe mange and malnutrition. She is under dermatological treatment and nutritional rehabilitation, and is not yet listed for adoption.
rescueStory: Trapped during a routine TNRM round near the campus residential blocks, Comel was too weak to be returned to her colony. She was admitted to the Rehabilitation House instead of being released, and has been gaining weight steadily since.

medical.specialNeeds: Sarcoptic mange under treatment; medicated baths weekly. Vaccination deferred until skin lesions resolve and weight reaches 3.2kg.

medicalTimeline.title: TNRM Trap Intake & Isolation
medicalTimeline.description: Trapped during a campus TNRM round. Severe generalised alopecia and crusting; body weight 1.9kg, BCS 2/9. Placed in the isolation ward.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Diperangkap semasa pusingan TNRM kampus. Keguguran bulu teruk dan kulit berkerak; berat badan 1.9kg, skor keadaan badan 2/9. Ditempatkan di wad pengasingan.

medicalTimeline.title: Skin Scraping & FIV/FeLV Screening
medicalTimeline.description: Skin scraping confirmed sarcoptic mange. FIV and FeLV snap tests both negative. Faecal float positive for roundworm.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Kikisan kulit mengesahkan kudis sarkoptik. Ujian FIV dan FeLV kedua-duanya negatif. Ujian najis positif cacing gelang.

medicalTimeline.title: Sterilisation & Ear-Tipping (TNRM Protocol)
medicalTimeline.description: Spay performed under the campus TNRM protocol with the standard left ear tip. Recovery uneventful.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Pembedahan pensterilan dilakukan mengikut protokol TNRM kampus dengan potongan hujung telinga kiri. Pemulihan lancar.

medicalTimeline.title: Weekly Medicated Bath & Nutrition Review
medicalTimeline.description: Third medicated bath completed; crusting reduced across the flanks. Weight up to 2.4kg on recovery wet food.
medicalTimeline.descriptionMs: Mandian berubat ketiga selesai; kerak kulit berkurangan di bahagian rusuk. Berat meningkat kepada 2.4kg dengan makanan basah pemulihan.

updates.title: Fur is starting to grow back
updates.content: After two medicated baths the crusting on Comel's flanks has softened and fine new fur is visible along her shoulders.
updates.contentMs: Selepas dua kali mandian berubat, kerak pada rusuk Comel semakin lembut dan bulu halus baharu kelihatan di bahagian bahunya.

updates.title: Eating on her own and purring
updates.content: Comel now finishes her recovery wet food unassisted and purrs when her carer refills the bowl — a first since intake.
updates.contentMs: Comel kini menghabiskan makanan basah pemulihannya tanpa bantuan dan berdengkur apabila penjaganya mengisi semula mangkuk — kali pertama sejak kemasukan.
